title: Total influence of majority functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a Boolean function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ that agrees with the sign of the sum of the input coordinates whenever that sum is nonzero. Then $f$ and the majority function have equal total influence.
